tryItExercises.title: Make one column the narrow-screen default
tryItExercises.prompt:
## CSS task

Before adding breakpoint enhancements, the narrow-screen experience needs one predictable base layout. Mobile-first CSS places the simple one-column default outside media queries so larger layouts become optional enhancements rather than requirements. Start the responsive phase from the fluid Grid checkpoint. Append `main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }` so the default layout is one column. Narrow the preview: main should resolve to a single readable column before any wider-screen rule applies.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
tryItExercises.hint: Set the narrow default directly on main, outside a media query.

help.concept: Mobile-first CSS places the simple one-column default outside media queries so larger layouts become optional enhancements rather than requirements.
help.hint_1: Set the narrow default directly on main, outside a media query.
help.hint_2: Narrow the preview: main should resolve to a single readable column before any wider-screen rule applies.

sketchBlocks.cardTitle: min-width enhances when space is available
sketchBlocks.title: min-width enhances when space is available

tryItExercises.title: Add the 48rem two-column enhancement
tryItExercises.prompt:
**Problem**

The one-column mobile-first base is safe, but medium-width screens have enough room for two equal Grid columns.

**Task**

Keep all prior CSS. Add the `@media (min-width: 48rem)` enhancement that gives `main` `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));`. Make only this responsive track change in this Try It.
tryItExercises.hint: Add the 48rem media query and change only main's Grid columns.

help.concept: Use a min-width media query to enhance the mobile-first Grid when more space is available.
help.hint_2: Inside it, set `main` to `repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))` columns.

tryItExercises.title: Keep direct Grid items shrink-safe
tryItExercises.prompt:
**Problem**

The 48rem two-column Grid is in place, but long intrinsic content can still force a direct Grid item wider than its track.

**Task**

Keep the two-column enhancement and add `main > * { min-width: 0; }` so direct Grid items may shrink inside their tracks.
tryItExercises.hint: Apply `min-width: 0` to each direct child of main.

help.concept: Grid items may need `min-width: 0` so intrinsic content can shrink within a track.

tryItExercises.title: Add the 64rem three-column enhancement
tryItExercises.prompt:
**Problem**

Wide screens have room for one more Grid track than the medium layout.

**Task**

Keep all prior responsive CSS. Add the `@media (min-width: 64rem)` enhancement that gives `main` `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));`. Make only the three-column enhancement in this Try It.
tryItExercises.hint: Add the 64rem media query and change main to three equal minmax tracks.

help.concept: A later min-width breakpoint can progressively enhance the Grid with another track.
help.hint_2: Inside it, set `main` to `repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))` columns.

tryItExercises.title: Let the first wide-layout item span two columns
tryItExercises.prompt:
**Problem**

The wide Grid now has three columns, but the first content item still occupies only one track.

**Task**

Keep the three-column enhancement. In a `@media (min-width: 64rem)` rule, set `main > :first-child` to `grid-column: span 2;` so only the first direct child becomes a wider feature at the wide breakpoint.
tryItExercises.hint: At 64rem and wider, make only the first direct child span two columns.

help.concept: Grid placement can change at a breakpoint without changing the HTML.
help.hint_1: Use `main > :first-child` inside a 64rem min-width media query.
